BOWMAN.gloss: a person who is expert in the use of a bow and arrow
BOWMAN.definition: A person who is expert in the use of a bow and arrow.

WOMAN.definition: An adult female person (as opposed to a man).
WOMAN.example: The woman kept house while the man hunted.

WOMB.gloss: a hollow muscular organ in the pelvic cavity of females
WOMB.definition: A hollow muscular organ in the pelvic cavity of females; contains the developing fetus.

MOAN.gloss: an utterance expressing pain or disapproval
MOAN.definition: An utterance expressing pain or disapproval.

MAN.gloss: an adult person who is male
MAN.definition: An adult person who is male (as opposed to a woman).
MAN.example: There were two women and six men on the bus.

BOW.gloss: a knot with two loops and loose ends
BOW.definition: A knot with two loops and loose ends; used to tie shoelaces.

NOW.definition: In the historical present; at this point in the narration of a series of past events.
NOW.example: President Kennedy now calls in the National Guard.

OWN.example: He owns three houses in Florida.

WON.gloss: the basic unit of money in South Korea
WON.definition: The basic unit of money in South Korea.

WAN.definition: (of light) lacking in intensity or brightness; dim or feeble.
WAN.example: The pale light of a half moon.
